move.twister: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This move has a 20% chance of making targets flinch, and can also hit a target that’s in the air from Fly, Bounce, or Sky Drop with its power doubled.
move.raindance: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for 5 turns, powering up Water-type moves by 50%. The rain also halves the damage dealt by Fire-type moves.
move.sunnyday: The user intensifies the sun for 5 turns, powering up Fire-type moves by 50%. The sunlight also halves the damage dealt by Water-type moves.
move.crunch: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.
move.mirrorcoat: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.
move.psychup: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
move.extremespeed: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
move.ancientpower: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This has a 10% chance of boosting the user’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats all at once.
move.shadowball: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This move has a 20% chance of lowering the target’s Sp. Def stat.
move.futuresight: 2 turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
move.rocksmash: The user attacks with a punch. This move has a 50% chance of lowering the target’s Defense stat.
move.whirlpool: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool. For 4-5 turns, the target takes damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn. This move’s power is doubled against targets submerged with Dive.
move.beatup: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target, attacking as many times as the number of healthy Pokémon in the user’s party. This move’s power is calculated based on the Attack stats of the party Pokémon.
move.fakeout: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. This move fails unless it is the first move used by the user after it enters a battle.
move.uproar: The user attacks in an uproar for 3 turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
move.stockpile: The user raises its Stockpiling level by 1 and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to 3 times.
move.spitup: The levels stored using the move Stockpile are released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 100 and 300).
move.swallow: The levels stored using the move Stockpile are absorbed by the user to restore its HP. Level 1: 1/4 of the user’s max HP is restored. Level 2: 1/2 of the user’s max HP is restored. Level 3: The user’s HP is fully restored.
move.heatwave: The user attacks by blasting opposing Pokémon with searingly hot wind. This move has a 10% chance of burning targets.
move.hail: The user summons a hailstorm lasting 5 turns. All Pokémon except Ice types will be damaged for 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn.
move.torment: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
move.flatter: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
move.willowisp: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.
move.memento: The user faints. In return, the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.
move.facade: This move’s power is doubled if the user is poisoned, badly poisoned, burned, or paralyzed. Although this move is a physical move, the damage it deals is not halved when the user is burned.
move.focuspunch: The user moves last to focus its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.
move.smellingsalts: This attack’s power is doubled when used on a target with paralysis. This also cures the target’s paralysis, however.
move.followme: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.
move.naturepower: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the biome or terrain this move was used in.
move.charge: The user becomes charged, doubling the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Def stat.
move.taunt: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for 3 turns.
move.helpinghand: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally’s attack by 50%.
move.trick: The user catches the target off guard and swaps a target’s held item with its own.
move.roleplay: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target’s Ability.
move.wish: One turn after this move is used, the user’s or its replacement’s HP is restored by up to 1/2 the user’s max HP
move.assist: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by ally Pokémon.
move.ingrain: The user lays roots that restore 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn. Because it’s rooted, the user becomes grounded and cannot flee or be switched out of battle.
move.superpower: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.
move.magiccoat: Until the end of the turn, certain non-damaging moves directed at the user are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.
move.recycle: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
move.revenge: The user moves last. The power of this move is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.
move.brickbreak: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers such as Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.
move.yawn: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
move.knockoff: The user slaps down a target’s held item, removing the item. This move’s power is boosted by 50% if the target has a held item.
move.endeavor: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target’s HP to roughly equal the user’s HP. This fails if the target’s HP is the same as or lower than the user’s. Boss Pokémon are immune to this move.
move.eruption: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The less HP the user has left, the lower this move’s power (ranging between 1 and 150).
move.skillswap: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.
move.imprison: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.
move.refresh: The user rests to cure itself of poisoning, a burn, or paralysis.

move.feint: This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.
move.pluck: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
move.tailwind: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that doubles the Speed stats of itself and its allies for 4 turns.
move.acupressure: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies’ stats.
move.metalburst: The user retaliates to deal 1.5x the damage it took from an opponent’s move during the turn this move is used.
move.uturn: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
move.closecombat: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

move.embargo: This move prevents the target from using its held items for 5 turns.
move.fling: The user flings one of its held items at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.
move.psychoshift: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.
move.trumpcard: This move’s power starts at 40 and increases as its remaining PP decreases: 50 at 4 PP, 60 at 3 PP, 80 at 2 PP, and 200 at 1 PP. This move never misses.
move.healblock: For 5 turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.
move.wringout: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 120).
move.powertrick: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
move.gastroacid: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability and Passive.
move.luckychant: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits for 5 turns.
move.mefirst: The user cuts ahead of the target to copy and use the target’s intended move, boosting its power by 50%. This move fails if it isn’t used first.
move.copycat: The user mimics the move that was last used. This move fails if no other move has been used yet, or if the last move used cannot be copied.

move.guardswap: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

move.suckerpunch: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

move.psyshock: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
move.venoshock: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.
move.autotomize: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter. This sharply boosts the user’s Speed stat.
move.ragepowder: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.

move.magicroom: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for 5 turns.

move.stormthrow: The user attacks by striking the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.
move.flameburst: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. Pokémon next to the target also take damage equal to 1/16 of their max HP.
move.sludgewave: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This move has a 10% chance of poisoning targets.
move.quiverdance: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
move.heavyslam: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 40 and 120). If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.
move.synchronoise: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.
move.electroball: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The higher the user’s Speed stat compared to the target’s, the greater this move’s power (ranging between 40 and 150).
move.soak: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target’s type to Water.
move.flamecharge: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.
move.coil: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
move.lowsweep: The user makes a swift attack on the target’s legs, which lowers the target’s Speed stat.
move.acidspray: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.
move.foulplay: The user turns the target’s strength against it. The damage dealt by this move is determined using the target’s Attack stat instead of the user’s Attack stat.
move.simplebeam: The user emits a mysterious psychic wave that changes the target’s Ability to Simple.
move.entrainment: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.
move.afteryou: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
move.round: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be doubled.
move.echoedvoice: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. This move’s power is increased by 40 each turn this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, up to a max of 200.

move.quickguard: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
move.allyswitch: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. With each consecutive use, this move’s chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.
move.scald: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target and will thaw out the user or target if one is frozen.
move.shellsmash: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
move.healpulse: The user emits a healing pulse that restores 1/2 of the target’s max HP.
move.hex: The user attacks with relentless intensity. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.
move.skydrop: The user takes the target into the sky on the first turn, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.
move.shiftgear: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.
move.circlethrow: The user attacks last. In return, the target is thrown and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

move.quash: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
move.acrobatics: The user nimbly strikes the target. The fewer held items, the higher the damage it inflicts (ranging between 55 and 110).

move.retaliate: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move’s power is doubled if an ally fainted in the previous turn.

move.bestow: The user passes a held item to the target.
move.inferno: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

move.eerieimpulse: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

move.ruination: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This deals damage to the target equal to 1/2 of their remaining HP.
move.collisioncourse: The user rushes forward and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.
move.electrodrift: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move’s power is boosted by 33% if it’s a supereffective hit.
move.shedtail: The user creates a substitute for itself using 1/2 of its max HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
move.chillyreception: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns.
move.tidyup: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.
move.snowscape: The user summons a snowstorm lasting 5 turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types by 50%.
move.pounce: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.
move.trailblaze: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user’s nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
move.chillingwater: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that’s so cold it saps the target’s power. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
move.hyperdrill: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
move.twinbeam: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
move.ragefist: The user attacks by converting its rage into energy. This move’s power is increased by 50 each time the user takes damage from a move, up to a maximum power of 350. If the user switches out of battle, the move’s power returns to its usual value.
move.armorcannon: The user attacks by shooting off its own armor as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
move.bitterblade: The user attacks by focusing all its bitter feelings toward this world into the tip of its blade. The user’s HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.
move.doubleshock: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack, and loses the Electric type. This move fails unless it is used by a Electric type.
move.gigatonhammer: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can’t be used twice in a row.
move.comeuppance: The user retaliates to deal 1.5x of the damage it took from an opponent’s move during the turn this move is used.
move.aquacutter: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage.
move.blazingtorque: The user rams into the target with blazing energy. This move has a 30% chance of burning the target.
move.wickedtorque: The user rams into the target with malicious intent. This move has a 10% chance of putting the target to sleep.
move.noxioustorque: The user rams into the target with a poisonous end. This move has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.
move.combattorque: The user rams into the target with great force. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.
move.magicaltorque: The user rams into the target with a fae-like force. This move has a 30% chance of confusing the target.
move.bloodmoon: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can’t be used twice in a row.
move.matchagotcha: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user’s HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move, and has a 20% chance of burning targets. This will also thaw out a frozen user or target.
move.syrupbomb: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target’s Speed stat to drop at the end of every turn for 3 turns.
move.ivycudgel: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move’s critical-hit ratio is boosted by 1 stage. When used by Ogerpon, this move’s type changes depending on the mask worn.
move.electroshot: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
move.terastarstorm: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user when Terastallized.
move.ficklebeam: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. There is a 30% chance that all of the user’s heads will shoot beams in unison, doubling the move’s power.
move.burningbulwark: The user intensely heats up a part of its body, protecting it from attacks and also causing burns to any attacker that makes direct contact with it.
move.thunderclap: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
move.mightycleave: The user wields the light that has accumulated through its blades to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
move.tachyoncutter: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.
move.hardpress: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power (ranging between 1 and 100).
move.dragoncheer: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. Dragon types receive a 2-stage boost. All other types receive a 1-stage boost.
move.alluringvoice: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
move.temperflare: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move’s power is doubled if the user’s previous move failed.
move.supercellslam: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. The user takes damage equal to 1/2 of its max HP if this move misses or fails. If the target has used Minimize, this move’s power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.
move.psychicnoise: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For 2 turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
move.upperhand: The user reacts to the target’s movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
move.malignantchain: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This move has a 50% chance of badly poisoning the target.
move.nihillight: The user attacks by unleashing a powerful light that defies all laws of nature, striking even Fairy types and ignoring any stat changes affecting its targets.
